An interactive crossword on lakes and wetlands rebuilt here with a custom made R package [`crosswordwidget`](https://github.com/ankurjamwal/crosswordwidget). Click a cell, type an answer, use the arrow keys to move around, and use Check or Reveal when you're ready. Happy crosswording!

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
devtools::load_all("C:/R projects/crosswordwidget")

clues <- data.frame(
  answer = c(
    "BENTHIC", "THERMOCLINE", "PROFUNDAL", "MANGROVE", "MARSH",
    "EUTROPHIC", "PHUMDI", "HYPOLIMNION", "LITTORAL", "EPILIMNION",
    "RAMSAR", "SWAMP"
  ),
  clue = c(
    "Term for organisms or processes at the lake or wetland bottom",
    "Zone of rapid temperature change separating a lake's warm and cold layers",
    "Deep lake zone below the compensation depth, too dark for photosynthesis",
    "Salt-tolerant coastal wetland tree with prop roots and pneumatophores",
    "Continuously inundated wetland dominated by soft-stemmed plants",
    "Nutrient-rich water body prone to algal blooms and oxygen depletion",
    "Meitei word for the floating vegetation mats of Loktak Lake",
    "Cold, dense, often oxygen-poor bottom layer of a stratified lake",
    "Shallow, near-shore lake zone where rooted plants grow",
    "Warm, sunlit, wind-mixed surface layer of a stratified lake",
    "Iranian city that gave its name to the global wetlands treaty",
    "Wetland dominated by woody vegetation such as trees and shrubs"
  )
)

crossword(clues)
```
